report_name: Homebuilder Lennar Corp. Breach Exposes SSNs via Social Engineering

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Social Engineering Actor
threat_actors.description: The unidentified actor(s) who conducted a social engineering attack against Lennar Corp. in March 2026 to exfiltrate sensitive personal data.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used sophisticated social engineering tactics, such as phishing or vishing, to manipulate employees into providing access credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used stolen credentials to log into Lennar's systems and access sensitive data.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: After gaining access, the attackers located and exfiltrated files containing sensitive personal information, including Social Security numbers and financial account details.

identities.name: Lennar Corp.
identities.description: A major U.S. homebuilder that was the victim of a social engineering data breach in March 2026, leading to the exposure of customer and/or employee personal and financial information.

indicators.name: Suspicious Email with Urgency Indicators
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Email with Urgency Indicators
id: 2b8a1c3d-f4e5-4b9a-8c7d-6e5f4d3c2b1a
status: experimental
description: Detects inbound emails with subject lines or body content that create a false sense of urgency, a common tactic in phishing attacks as described in the Lennar Corp. breach analysis.
references:
  - https://www.kaseya.com/blog/the-week-in-breach-news-08-05-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1566
level: low
logsource:
  category: email
detection:
  selection_subject:
    Subject|contains:
      - 'Urgent'
      - 'Action Required'
      - 'Immediate Attention'
      - 'Security Alert'
  selection_body:
    Body|contains:
      - 'verify your account'
      - 'unusual sign-in activity'
      - 'password expires'
      - 'click here to login'
  condition: 1 of them
indicators.description: Detects emails with hallmarks of phishing, such as a false sense of urgency, which was a likely vector in the social engineering attack against Lennar Corp.
